_comment: What each stage of /drive cost this slice and how well it did, one entry per stage run, appended by scripts/agents/benchmark.py at the stage's start and end. Tokens come from the harness's own transcript or are null with the reason; signals are what the stage reported. `make benchmark` reads every record. docs/agent-harnesses.md says what the numbers can and cannot be compared with.

stages.planned: plan: strong → host model — `strong` maps to the host model

usage.read: message.usage on each assistant line, once per requestId
